category: embedding inference tied to a vector database cluster, daily request cap on a free cluster

free_tier.stated: usable on a free Weaviate Cloud cluster at 2,000 embedding requests per cluster per day; with 200 objects per batch that is at most 400,000 embeddings a day. Text models: snowflake-arctic-embed-m-v1.5 and -l-v2.0; multimodal: ModernVBERT/colmodernvbert; no reranker is listed
free_tier.notes: the service is called from a cluster, with no separate key: 'you only need a connection to your Weaviate Cloud cluster'

tooling: Weaviate client libraries vectorize on import and query; the service is enabled by default for every cluster. Enable vector_config Configure.Vectors.text2vec_weaviate() (Python) / text2vecWeaviate (JS, Java, C#); Go has no direct support and must pass X-Weaviate-Api-Key and X-Weaviate-Cluster-Url headers manually. The optional base_url vectorizer parameter overrides the service origin, but the server accepts only https://api.embedding.weaviate.io or an origin in MODULES_WEAVIATE_EMBEDDINGS_ALLOWED_BASE_URLS.
chaining: embeddings stay inside the same free cluster that stores the vectors

limits.value: 2,000 requests per cluster per day on a free cluster; batch import is capped at 200 objects per batch, so at most 400,000 embeddings per day

interface_detail: Weaviate Embeddings is a managed service at POST https://api.embedding.weaviate.io/v1/embeddings/embed with a JSON body of input / model / dimensions / optional is_search_query, authenticated by an Authorization Bearer token (Weaviate Cloud API key or OIDC token) and an X-Weaviate-Cluster-Url header. Callers reach it through a Weaviate Cloud cluster text2vec-weaviate vectorizer over the cluster REST/gRPC API; no separate key is needed (cluster credentials authorize it).
